# Chain News

> Chain News is an independent crypto analysis desk: what changed in protocols, markets and regulation, how it compares, and what to watch next.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://newscryptoworld.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://newscryptoworld.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://newscryptoworld.github.io/archive/): everything published.
